train_model: train a fairseq model on one or multiple GPUs with configurable epochs and validation
validate_model: validate a trained fairseq model on specified dataset subsets and return losses
save_checkpoint: save model checkpoints at epoch or update intervals with best-loss tracking
load_checkpoint: load a fairseq model checkpoint and replay the dataloader state to match
load_dataset_splits: load train and validation dataset splits for a fairseq task
